Full summary: Wave 1 T1: S0 amnesia guard shipped — hasSqliteState now requires nonzero size + SQLite magic header; rewrote the two tests that enshrined the 0-byte-db→sqlite behavior; added 4 regressions (amnesia arm, crash-artifact-alone, garbage-db, records-rehydration arm). 19/19 green.
Decisions: Chose header check (16-byte SQLite magic) over size>0 alone for the S0 guard — a garbage-header db beside legacy content must also land on files per the module's ambiguity rule; a size>0 corrupt db beside nothing still resolves fresh→sqlite where openDatabase's failure hits the factory's existing files-fallback catch, so no new unsafe path opens.
